description: Figure 7 displays the Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs. The x-axis represents the number of training samples, with labeled tick marks at 8, 16, 32, and 64, indicating discrete, equally spaced intervals. The y-axis represents the Micro F1 (%) score, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The plot shows a single line that starts at approximately 50% for 8 samples, rises to a peak near 80% at 32 samples, and then remains relatively constant at approximately 75% for both 64 samples and the subsequent data point shown.
